1056.description: Pull a knee toward your chest while lying down. It releases the glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1120.description: A strap row to mid-chest height that works the upper back and arms using your body weight.
instructions: Grip the handles and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands, elbows close by.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Step forward to ease the load.

1184.description: An inverted row with extra weight placed on your body for added back challenge.
instructions: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it with extra weight on your torso.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
Keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

1248.description: Lying on your back and swinging bent legs side to side. It trains the obliques and lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides for support.
Lift your knees to 90 degrees.
Lower both knees to one side, stopping before the floor.
Bring them back to the middle and go to the other side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.

1312.description: Push a medicine ball forward from your chest, then sprint after it and catch it. It trains explosive chest power plus quick acceleration.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball at chest level.
Step forward with your right foot and simultaneously push the medicine ball forward, extending your arms fully.
As you push the ball forward, release it and let it roll forward.
Quickly run forward and catch the ball before it hits the ground.
Once you catch the ball, bring it back to your chest and repeat the movement with your left foot forward.
Continue alternating legs and repeating the exercise for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将药球举至胸部水平。
右脚向前迈出一步，同时向前推动药球，充分伸展双臂。
当你向前推动球时，松开它并让它向前滚动。
快速向前跑，在球落地之前接住球。
接住球后，将其放回胸前，左脚向前重复该动作。
继续交替双腿并重复练习达到所需的重复次数。

1376.description: A one-leg standing calf raise using a cable for resistance. It trains each calf separately and helps balance.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold onto the cable machine for support.
Lift one leg off the ground and balance on the other leg.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
抓住电缆机以获得支撑。
将一条腿抬离地面并用另一条腿保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

1440.description: A plank where you lift one arm at a time, training core stability and anti-rotation strength.
instructions: Get into a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips rotate.
Place it back down with control and lift the other.
Keep your neck neutral and alternate arms for the planned reps.

1504.description: A lying triceps extension using a band for resistance. It isolates the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Anchor the band behind your head and lie on your back holding the ends.
Start with your arms straight above your chest.
Bend only your elbows to lower your hands toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back up against the band.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.

1568.description: A one-armed kettlebell swing driven by the hips. It builds the posterior chain and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders and hold a kettlebell with one hand.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bell float up to chest height.
Keep your arm relaxed and your back flat.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again, then switch hands after your reps.

1632.description: A cable curl where you drag the handle up along your body. It trains the biceps with the elbows pulled back.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable attachment with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the cable attachment towards your shoulders by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the cable attachment back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆附件，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并通过收缩二头肌将电缆附件卷曲至肩膀。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将电缆附件放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1696.description: A lunge that steps diagonally or rotates, loading the legs from a different angle.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Step diagonally back or across your body into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are bent, keeping your chest upright.
Push through the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate sides for the planned reps.

1760.description: A squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. Trains the quads and glutes while keeping your torso upright.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住哑铃垂直放在胸前。
保持胸部挺直，核心收紧，通过向后推臀部并弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1824.description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with radial deviation.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1888.description: Simple standing stretch for the Achilles tendon and calf.
instructions: Stand near a wall or support.
Step one foot back with the heel down.
Slightly bend the back knee to target the lower Achilles.
Keep your back foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1952.description: A partner-assisted leg movement that gently stretches the hip and thigh.
instructions: Lie on your back and relax.
Have a partner support one leg and gently extend it.
Let the partner move the leg only to a mild stretch.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

2144.description: A seated cable press pushing the handles away from your chest. Builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and cable handles to a comfortable position.
Sit on the bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip at shoulder height.
Push the handles forward and away from your body, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将座椅高度和电缆手柄调整至舒适的位置。
坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住电缆手柄，与肩同高。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，充分伸展双臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2208.description: Rolling your back over a roller to loosen it up. Helps ease stiffness along the spine.
instructions: Start by sitting on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place the roller perpendicular to your body, just below your glutes.
Slowly roll your body backwards, allowing the roller to move up your back.
Continue rolling until the roller reaches your upper back.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将滚轮垂直于您的身体放置，位于臀部下方。
慢慢向后滚动你的身体，让滚轮向上移动你的背部。
继续滚动，直到滚轮到达您的上背部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢滚回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2272.description: A quick straight punch with the lead hand, used to build speed, shoulder endurance and timing.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your lead foot forward and hands up by your chin.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the target.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down as it lands.
Keep your chin tucked and your rear hand guarding.
Snap the hand back to the guard quickly.
Repeat, then switch stance if you want.

2336.description: A bench press form check that shows how the forearms should line up under the bar for a safe and strong press.
instructions: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your forearms vertical when the bar is at your chest.
Lower the bar with control to the mid-chest.
Press it up to straight arms without flaring the elbows.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2400.description: A bodyweight inverse leg curl using a pull-up cable machine setup. Targets the hamstrings.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle straps are at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs extended and the ankle straps attached to your feet.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Bend your knees and curl your legs towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstrings.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整缆绳机，使踝带处于最低设置。
面朝下躺在长凳上，双腿伸展，脚踝带固定在脚上。
握住长凳的把手以保持稳定。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀部弯曲，挤压腿筋。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2464.description: A one-arm cable row with a rotating kayak-style pull. Trains the lats and upper back.
instructions: Attach a cable handle to a low pulley and sit facing the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handle with your right hand and extend your arm fully, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight and your abs engaged.
Pull the handle towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blade and bending your elbow, keeping your arm close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform with your left arm.
instructionsZh: 将电缆手柄连接到低滑轮上，面向机器坐着，双脚平放在地板上。
用右手抓住手柄，完全伸展手臂，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
从臀部开始向前倾斜，保持背部挺直并收紧腹肌。
缩回肩胛骨并弯曲肘部，将手柄拉向躯干，保持手臂靠近身体。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边并用左臂执行。

2656.description: A one-arm curl using a cable for constant tension, great for working each biceps on its own.
instructions: Stand facing the cable with the handle at low height and grip it with one hand, palm up.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder and squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly until the arm is nearly straight.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

2720.description: A squat while holding a heavy platform, building leg strength and trunk stability.
instructions: Stand with the platform loaded on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over toes.
Drive back up through your heels.
Stand tall and lock out at the top.

2784.description: Bringing the arm forward in a horizontal plane, working the chest and front shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Bring the arm forward in front of your chest, keeping it level.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to the side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2848.description: A side-plank style Pilates move where one leg lifts, challenging the obliques and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a side plank on one hand.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift your top leg.
Hold briefly.
Lower and switch sides.

2912.description: Carrying a loaded trap bar at your sides while walking. It works grip, traps and the whole trunk together.
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and hinge down to grip the handles.
Stand up with a flat back, shoulders back and chest tall.
Walk with short, quick steps, keeping the bar still.
Cover the set distance without leaning or shrugging.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

2976.description: A squat that flows into a press with a landmine bar. It works legs and shoulders in one smooth motion.
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press the bar away until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar to your chest and repeat.

3040.description: A cable overhead extension from a high pulley that isolates the triceps.
instructions: Attach a bar to a high pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows pointing forward.
Step forward and stagger your feet.
Extend your arms to press the bar overhead.
Lower slowly back and keep your elbows in place.

3168.description: A squat paired with a pulling motion on a sturdy anchor or suspension trainer. It trains the legs and upper back in one flowing movement.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding onto a sturdy object or suspension trainer with your arms extended.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and your knees behind your toes.
From the squat position, pull your body up towards the object or suspension trainer, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，伸直手臂抓住坚固的物体或悬挂训练器。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，膝盖位于脚趾后面。
从蹲姿开始，将身体向上拉向物体或悬挂训练器，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3232.description: A standing cable row with a rope that pulls the elbows wide. It targets the rear delts.
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable at chest height.
Hold the ends and step back.
Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your rear shoulders.
Return slowly.

3296.description: A gymnastics hold with the body straight and parallel to the ground while hanging from a bar. It trains the abs, lats and upper back.
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Simultaneously, lift your legs up and extend them straight out in front of you, keeping your body parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for a full front lever position.
To release, slowly lower your legs back down and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
同时，抬起双腿并将其伸直在您面前，保持身体与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持此位置，以达到完全前杆位置。
要释放，请慢慢降低双腿并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3360.description: A crawl on hands and feet with the knees hovering off the floor. It works the shoulders, core and legs together.
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Lift your knees slightly off the ground, keeping your back flat and your core engaged.
Move your right hand and left foot forward simultaneously, followed by your left hand and right foot.
Continue crawling forward, alternating your hand and foot movements.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core tight throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired distance or time.
instructionsZh: 从四肢着地开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，膝盖直接放在臀部下方。
将膝盖稍微抬离地面，保持背部平坦并收紧核心。
同时向前移动右手和左脚，然后是左手和右脚。
继续向前爬行，手脚交替动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的节奏并保持核心紧张。
继续所需的距离或时间。

3488.description: A push-up that flows into a cobra-style chest opening at the top. It trains the chest and arms and works the back and spine.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows tucked.
Press up and keep going, letting your hips sink forward.
Lift your chest and look slightly up, like a cobra.
Return to the plank by lifting your hips back.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.

3552.description: A quick on-the-spot footwork drill with fast, light steps. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Begin by rapidly moving your feet up and down, as if you were running in place.
Keep your movements quick and light, focusing on staying on the balls of your feet.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
首先快速上下移动双脚，就像原地跑步一样。
保持动作快速而轻盈，重点放在脚掌上。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。

3616.description: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together to emphasise the quads.
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.

3680.description: A kettlebell swing with an overhand grip that builds explosive hip power and a strong posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with an overhand grip.
Hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping your back flat.

3744.description: A no-equipment fly that uses a bed sheet pulled apart to work the rear shoulders.
instructions: Hold a bed sheet taut in both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull your hands apart, opening your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep tension on the sheet.

3872.description: A controlled drop of the heels off a step that stretches and strengthens the calves and ankles.
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with the balls of your feet on it.
Hold a rail for balance.
Rise onto your toes.
Slowly lower your heels below the step level.
Pause and feel the stretch in your calves.
Raise up and repeat.

4000.description: A lunge held in one place with no stepping. It builds the legs and balance.
instructions: Step one foot forward and stay in a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Push through the front heel.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

4064.description: Back squat with chains hanging from the bar, so the load grows as you stand. It builds leg strength through the whole range.
instructions: Set chains on the bar and unrack it onto your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through your feet.
Keep your core braced throughout.

4128.description: A squat holding a weight out in front as a counterweight, helping you stay upright.
instructions: Hold a weight at chest height and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms forward as you descend.
Squat until thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand back up through your heels.

4192.description: A push up on your knuckles to keep wrists straight. It builds chest and arm strength.
instructions: Make fists and place them under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest.
Press up.
Keep wrists neutral.
Brace your core.

4256.description: A single-leg squat that lowers you off a step. It builds quad strength and knee control.
instructions: Stand on a step with one foot hanging off the edge.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down on the standing leg and lower the free heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up to the start.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

4384.description: A plank variation where you rock your body forward and back in small motions. It heavily challenges the abs and shoulders.
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Shift your body forward so your shoulders move past your elbows.
Rock back to the start in a slow, smooth motion.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.

4448.description: A barbell hip thrust with a band around the knees to add outward tension. Strongly works the glutes and hip stabilisers.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench, a padded barbell over your hips and a band above your knees.
Plant your feet hip width apart and push your knees out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Keep your chin tucked and ribs down.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

4512.description: A seated stretch for the inner thighs. Improves hip flexibility.
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your ankles and sit tall.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Gently press your elbows on your thighs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

4576.description: A straight-arm band pulldown that isolates the lats.
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the ends with arms extended in front of you.
Stand with a slight forward lean and a braced core.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull the band down in an arc until your hands reach your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.

4768.description: Lying on an incline, you alternate straight-leg flutter kicks. It trains the lower abs.
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench and hold the edges behind your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down alternately in small motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set time or reps.

4832.description: Lying face down, you raise light dumbbells out to the sides. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang down with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

4896.description: A kneeling side kick with a straight leg. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the knee straight.
Lift the leg to about hip height.
Keep your hips and back steady.
Lower with control without touching down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4960.description: A triceps extension performed from a high cable position. It builds the triceps.
instructions: Set the cable high and face it.
Hold the attachment with elbows bent.
Press down by extending your elbows.
Squeeze at the bottom.
Return slowly.
Keep your elbows near your sides.

5024.description: Wall slide with a band around the forearms to engage the serratus. It improves shoulder blade control.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a band around your forearms just below the elbows.
Place your forearms on the wall and push slightly outward against the band.
Slide your arms up the wall, reaching overhead.
Keep your ribs down and shoulder blades moving freely.
Slide back down slowly.

5088.description: Pull a cable handle across your body with your elbow tucked at your side. It trains the internal rotators of the shoulder.
instructions: Set a cable at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with your elbow tucked against your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across your stomach.
Return slowly, keeping your elbow pinned.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

5152.description: Rise from a half-kneeling position to standing. It is a bodyweight move for hip and leg strength and balance.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front.
Hold your arms in front of you for balance.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Lower back down under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5216.description: Short, all-out running efforts. It builds speed and conditioning.
instructions: Warm up well with jogging and dynamic stretches.
Start in a staggered stance and lean slightly forward.
Drive your arms and knees as you accelerate.
Run at maximum effort for 10-30 seconds.
Slow down gradually and rest fully before the next sprint.

5344.description: Hold a V-shaped position with legs and torso lifted. Builds strong abs and balance.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Lift your legs and straighten them to form a V.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Keep your chest open and back from rounding.
Lower with control.

5408.description: A lunge with a trunk twist while holding a stick. Stretches the hip flexors and loosens the spine.
instructions: Hold the stick across your chest or in front with both hands and step into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Twist your torso over the front leg.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, breathing evenly.
Untwist, step back and switch legs.

5472.description: Floor ab exercise where you lift bent knees toward your chest, working the lower abs with less lever length than straight legs.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips or by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor.
Curl your hips up slightly as you bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your legs slowly without letting your lower back arch.
Repeat for the target reps.

5664.description: Seated leg extension using a cable for the quads.
instructions: Sit on a bench with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Hold the bench.
Extend your leg until straight.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.

5856.description: A seated one-arm curl with the elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps with a strict path.
instructions: Sit with your legs apart and a kettlebell in one hand.
Rest your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

5984.description: A cone drill with a set number of steps forward and back to sharpen speed and quick direction changes.
instructions: Set a cone line a few yards apart.
Sprint to the first cone and touch it, then back to the start.
Sprint to the second cone and back.
Go to the third cone and back.
Stay low when turning.
Rest, then repeat.

6048.description: A lunge stepping backward while holding bottles. It is easy on the knees and trains the glutes and quads.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and your chest up.
Push through the front heel to come back.
Alternate legs, or finish one side then switch.

6304.description: A standing balance with a back-held leg and a forward reach. It stretches the quads and opens the chest.
instructions: Stand tall and bend one knee, holding that foot behind you.
Kick your foot back into your hand.
Reach your free arm forward.
Tilt your torso forward as the leg lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.

6560.description: A seated hip stretch with both legs bent at right angles. It loosens the hip rotators and the glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front and the other bent out to the side, both at about 90 degrees.
Sit tall with your hands on the floor.
Hinge forward over the front shin until you feel a stretch in the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Come back up slowly.
Switch sides.

6752.description: A small, focused crunch from lying down. It helps you feel the front abdominal muscle working.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly on your abs or behind your head.
Exhale and curl your shoulders off the floor.
Feel the abs tighten at the top.
Lower back slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

6880.description: A forearm balance that builds strong shoulders and core, also known as feathered peacock pose.
instructions: Start on your forearms and knees with your elbows under your shoulders.
Press your forearms into the floor and tuck your toes.
Lift your hips high and walk your feet toward your elbows.
Swing or float one leg up, then bring the other to meet it.
Keep your ribs in and your gaze between your hands.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.

6944.description: A standing or floor drill that copies the front crawl arm stroke. It raises your heart rate and warms the shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing one arm forward and over in a crawl stroke.
Alternate arms in a smooth, continuous rhythm.
Rotate your torso slightly with each stroke.
Keep going at a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

7200.description: A seated band move pressing the knees apart to work the outer hips.
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with the band just above your knees.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Press your knees out against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring the knees back slowly.
Keep your back straight throughout.

7328.description: Hyperextension with a dumbbell held to your chest to load the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Set up on a hyperextension bench with the pads at your hips.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise up until your body forms a straight line.
Avoid overarching at the top.

7584.description: A kneeling cable chop that moves from high to low while your torso resists twisting. It trains the deep core and obliques to stay stable.
instructions: Kneel side-on to a high cable and hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Chop the handle diagonally down across your body, arms mostly straight.
Do not let your torso rotate; the arms and shoulders do the travel.
Return slowly under control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

7648.description: A one-leg deadlift holding the dumbbell on the same side as the standing leg, for hamstrings and balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as your standing leg.
Shift your weight to that leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach the weight toward the floor.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

8224.description: A renegade row using a resistance band. It trains the core while the lats and back do the pulling.
instructions: Anchor a band and get into a plank facing it.
Hold the band in one hand.
Row your elbow back to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Return slowly and alternate arms.

8608.description: A wide-stance squat with a band adding resistance to the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet wider than shoulders and toes angled out.
Hold the band at your chest or shoulders.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.

8800.description: A Romanian deadlift in a staggered stance on the smith machine. It focuses on the hamstrings and glutes of the front leg.
instructions: Stand under the smith bar with one foot slightly behind the other.
Grip the bar and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch which foot is forward after your set.

9184.description: Using a stick, you guide one arm out and up to the side. It opens up shoulder range overhead.
instructions: Hold a stick with both hands in front of you.
Keep one arm relaxed and guide it with the other.
Raise the stick sideways and up.
Keep your torso upright.
Pause at the top.
Lower and switch sides.

9248.description: Quick shuffling steps forward and back build footwork and conditioning. It keeps your heart rate up.
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with soft knees.
Shuffle forward a few steps on the balls of your feet.
Shuffle back to the start without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and your chest up.
Move quickly but stay balanced.
Repeat for a set time.

9312.description: With your hands on a high bar, you do an easier incline push up. A great stepping stone toward floor push ups.
instructions: Set a bar at about waist or chest height.
Place your hands on it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back so your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core and glutes tight.

9696.description: A deadlift with a wide, toes-out stance. It shortens the range and loads the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and a bar over mid-foot.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the bar.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar with control.

10592.description: From half kneeling, straighten the front leg and lean forward to stretch the hamstring. It lengthens the back of the thigh.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended, heel on the floor.
Keep your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

10656.description: Straighten your knees on a reformer pressing through the heels. It works the thighs.
instructions: Lie on the carriage with heels on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out through the heels until straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your hips level.

10848.description: Reformer footwork that alternates the legs like running. It trains the calves, quads and glutes.
instructions: Lie on the reformer with the balls of your feet on the bar.
Straighten both legs.
Lower one heel while bending the other knee.
Alternate smoothly.
Keep your pelvis still.
Maintain steady breathing.

10912.description: A one-foot toe curl while seated. It trains the muscles under the foot.
instructions: Sit on a chair and place one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and squeeze.
Hold for a second or two.
Relax and spread the toes.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

0032.description: Lift the bar from the floor by driving the hips and legs until you stand tall. Trains the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the ground in front of you.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower your torso and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted as you drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
As you stand up straight, squeeze your glutes and keep your core engaged.
Lower the barbell back down to the ground by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，杠铃放在你面前的地面上。
弯曲膝盖并以臀部为铰链，降低躯干，正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
当你通过脚后跟将杠铃抬离地面时，保持背部挺直，胸部抬起，伸展臀部和膝盖。
当你站直时，挤压你的臀部并保持你的核心参与。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，将杠铃放回地面，保持背部挺直。
重复所需的重复次数。

0096.description: A side bend with the bar on your shoulders. Works the obliques.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with both hands, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Slowly bend your torso to the right side, lowering the barbell towards your right knee.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement on the left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住杠铃，掌心朝下。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直并保持核心参与。
慢慢地将你的躯干弯曲到右侧，将杠铃向右膝方向降低。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在左侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0160.description: A wide-grip cable row seated on the floor. Targets the upper back.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and your back straight.
Attach a cable handle to a low pulley and position the cable machine behind you.
Grasp the handle with a wide overhand grip, palms facing down.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and your chest lifted.
Pull the handle towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸直，背部挺直。
将缆绳手柄连接到低滑轮上，并将缆绳机放在您身后。
正手宽握握住手柄，手掌朝下。
稍微向后倾斜，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将手柄拉向腰部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0224.description: A standing cable wrist curl with the arms hanging behind or at the sides. It builds the forearms and grip.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and your elbows close to your sides.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the cable handle towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝下。
保持手臂伸直，肘部靠近身体两侧。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将电缆手柄拉向身体。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0288.description: A dumbbell pullover done in a wide arc lying on a bench. It stretches and trains the chest and lats.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet firmly on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head in an arc motion.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚牢牢踩在地上。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持手臂伸直，以弧线动作慢慢将哑铃降低到脑后。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0352.description: A dumbbell bench press with palms facing each other. It works the chest, front shoulders and triceps with a shoulder-friendly grip.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and your arms extended straight up over your chest.
Slowly lower the dumbbells down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
每只手握一个哑铃，中立握法（手掌相对），双臂伸直越过胸部。
慢慢地将哑铃降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将哑铃推回起始位置，完全伸展手臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0416.description: Standing tall, you curl dumbbells to your shoulders. The classic biceps builder.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0480.description: A running-in-place move where you twist to bring the elbow to the lifted knee. It raises your heart rate and engages the trunk.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee high and twist your torso to meet it with the opposite elbow.
Lower and switch sides.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Go for 30-60 seconds.

0544.description: A single leg squat holding a kettlebell at your chest as a counterweight. Builds leg strength, balance and mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your chest with both hands.
Lift your left foot off the ground and extend it forward, keeping it parallel to the ground.
Slowly lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your right foot flat on the ground and your left leg extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住壶铃放在胸前。
将左脚抬离地面并向前伸展，保持与地面平行。
慢慢地将身体降低到蹲姿，保持右脚平放在地面上，左腿伸展。
在深蹲底部暂停片刻，然后推动右脚跟返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

0608.description: A seated machine twist that trains the abs and obliques through rotation.
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pads so your torso is secure.
Grip the handles and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side in a controlled way.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return to the centre and rotate to the other side.
Move slowly and avoid using momentum.

0672.description: You lower and press your body between parallel bars with your hands behind you. Works the triceps and shoulders.
instructions: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0736.description: The classic sit up, curling your torso from the floor to upright. It builds strength in the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest your fingertips by your head.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Avoid yanking on your neck; lead with your chest.

0800.description: A step up that finishes with a twist, bringing an elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the legs, trunk and coordination.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy step with hands by your head.
Step up with your right foot and drive the left knee up.
Twist to bring your right elbow toward your left knee.
Step down carefully and reset.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.

0864.description: A shoulder exercise raising the arms to the side and rotating the dumbbells upward. It strengthens the rotator cuff and delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Rotate your arms externally, bringing the dumbbells up towards your head while keeping your elbows in the same position.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
向外旋转手臂，将哑铃举向头部，同时保持肘部处于同一位置。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0928.description: A pulldown with straight arms using a band. It isolates the lats.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and stand facing it.
Hold the ends with straight arms.
Pull your hands down toward your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.

0992.description: A sit-up that pushes a band forward as you come up. It trains the abs.
instructions: Attach the band securely to a stable anchor point.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with both hands and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将带子牢固地固定在稳定的锚点上。
平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
用双手握住弹力带，并将双臂伸向天花板。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
